content: Post-lingual deafness refers to the onset of hearing loss that occurs after an individual has acquired spoken language, typically after the age of three. This condition implies that the affected person had normal hearing during the critical period of language development and subsequently lost their ability to hear. If you are interested in contributing to the development of this topic, you are encouraged to apply for the role of Editor-in-Chief. There can be one or multiple Editors-in-Chief for this subject. Additionally, you may apply to serve as an Associate Editor-in-Chief for one of the subtopics related to post-lingual deafness. To express your interest in either role, please send an email indicating your preferred position. Be sure to include your curriculum vitae (CV) and/or a biographical sketch to support your application.
